name: astrolith
description: Astrolith - Fullstack Monorepo with Node.js/Express, SQLite, WebSockets, Three.js, React, and Zustand

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run preview --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
